# Plaid

> Plaid helps all companies build fintech solutions by making it easy, safe and reliable for people to connect their financial data to apps and services.

## Reach more customers worldwide with over 95% bank coverage and localized support across 20 countries

# Main documentation:
# - Summary: https://plaid.com/docs/llms.txt
# - Full: https://plaid.com/docs/llms-full.txt

# Core Exchange documentation:
# - Summary: https://plaid.com/core-exchange/docs/llms.txt
# - Full: https://plaid.com/core-exchange/docs/llms-full.txt


## Documentation: Overview
- [Home](https://plaid.com/docs/index.html.md): Plaid developer documentation home. Here you'll find guides, resources, and references you can use to build with Plaid

## Documentation: Account
- [Account - Activity, logs, and status](https://plaid.com/docs/account/activity/index.html.md): Information on the Plaid Dashboard institution insights and account activity
- [Account - Pricing and billing](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/index.html.md): Learn about our one-time, subscription, and per-request flat fee pricing models. Learn which Plaid products fall under each pricing model
- [Account - Overview](https://plaid.com/docs/account/index.html.md): Learn about your Plaid developer account
- [Account - For resellers](https://plaid.com/docs/account/resellers/index.html.md): Learn how to create and manage your customers as a Plaid reseller partner
- [Account - Security](https://plaid.com/docs/account/security/index.html.md): Learn about resetting passwords, account management, two-factor authentication, and key rotations to protect your developer account and keep your keys safe.
- [Account - Teams](https://plaid.com/docs/account/teams/index.html.md): Learn about Plaid teams, which let you manage memberships and permissions to effectively collaborate across different teams and companies.

## Documentation: Api

- [API - Consent](https://plaid.com/docs/api/consent/index.html.md): API reference for managing consent
- [API - Overview](https://plaid.com/docs/api/index.html.md): Comprehensive reference for integrating with Plaid API endpoints
- [API - Institutions](https://plaid.com/docs/api/institutions/index.html.md): API reference for institutions endpoints used to fetch institutions-related data. Use these endpoints to assess the health of institutions and more.
- [API - Items](https://plaid.com/docs/api/items/index.html.md): API reference for managing Items. Items, created with Link, enable access to Plaid products.
- [API - Look up Dashboard users](https://plaid.com/docs/api/kyc-aml-users/index.html.md): API reference for viewing Dashboard users for Monitor
- [API - Libraries](https://plaid.com/docs/api/libraries/index.html.md): Learn about libraries and SDKs to easily integrate with the Plaid APIs
- [API - Link](https://plaid.com/docs/api/link/index.html.md): API reference for Link tokens and Link webhooks
- [API - OAuth](https://plaid.com/docs/api/oauth/index.html.md): API reference for Plaid OAuth endpoints
- [API - Reseller partners](https://plaid.com/docs/api/partner/index.html.md): API reference for Reseller Partner endpoints and webhooks used to manage reseller partner end customers.
- [API - Postman Collection](https://plaid.com/docs/api/postman/index.html.md): Learn more about the Plaid Postman Collection, which allows you to send API requests without code
- [API - Processor partners](https://plaid.com/docs/api/processor-partners/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints for use by Plaid partners
- [API - Processor tokens](https://plaid.com/docs/api/processors/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints for use with Plaid partners
- [API - Assets](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/assets/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Assets product.
- [API - Auth](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/auth/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Auth product.

- [API - Identity Verification](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/identity-verification/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Identity Verification product.
- [API - Identity](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/identity/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Identity product.
- [API - Income](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/income/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Income product.
- [API - Investments Move](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/investments-move/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Investments Move product.
- [API - Investments](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/investments/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Investments product.
- [API - Plaid Layer](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/layer/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints associated with the Plaid Layer product.
- [API - Liabilities](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/liabilities/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Liabilities product.
- [API - Monitor](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/monitor/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Monitor product.
- [API - Payment Initiation (Europe)](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/payment-initiation/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Payment Initiation product.

- [API - Program Metrics](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/metrics/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints to view your Transfer configuration and usage
- [API - Transfer for Platforms](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/platform-payments/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Transfer for Platforms product.
- [API - Reading Transfers](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/reading-transfers/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks to read Plaid transfers and transfer events.
- [API - Recurring Transfers](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/recurring-transfers/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks to create and manage recurring transfers.
- [API - Refunds](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transfer/refunds/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints to create and manage transfer refunds.
- [API - Virtual Accounts](https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/virtual-accounts/index.html.md): API reference for endpoints and webhooks associated with the Plaid Virtual Accounts product.
- [API - Sandbox](https://plaid.com/docs/api/sandbox/index.html.md): API reference for Plaid's Sandbox endpoints. Use these endpoints to configure testing scenarios, create sample webhooks, and more.
- [API - Users](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/index.html.md): API reference for Users
- [API - New User API migration guide](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/migrate-to-new-user-apis/index.html.md): Guide for migrating Consumer Report and Income integrations from legacy User APIs to new User APIs
- [API - New User API overview](https://plaid.com/docs/api/users/user-apis/index.html.md): API reference for users
- [API - API versioning](https://plaid.com/docs/api/versioning/index.html.md): Keep track of changes and updates to the Plaid API
- [API - Webhooks](https://plaid.com/docs/api/webhooks/index.html.md): API reference for webhooks, which allow you to receive programmatic updates when an Item goes into an error state or its account information is updated
- [API - Webhook events](https://plaid.com/docs/api/webhooks/webhook-events/index.html.md): Use the webhook events endpoint to recover webhooks your endpoint may have missed.
- [API - Webhook verification](https://plaid.com/docs/api/webhooks/webhook-verification/index.html.md): API reference for authenticating Plaid webhooks, which provide you with precise real-time information, to avoid abuse and improve security.

## Documentation: Assets

- [Auth - Money movement partnerships](https://plaid.com/docs/auth/partnerships/index.html.md): Find payment providers who have partnered with Plaid to provide general purpose ACH money movement
